name: Living Lore — power and toughness are the mana value of the card exiled with it
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). "This card's power and toughness are each equal to the exiled card's mana value." parsed to nothing. Now a characteristic-defining effect in layer 7a reading the exile entry tagged to Living Lore (it has no Imprint keyword and no Imprint button; the card is tagged in the exile zone). Time Stretch (mana value 10) exiled with it: 10/10; an untagged card in exile is ignored. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build in its own process.
